title: Robust Well-Log Reconstruction Across Point Gaps and Whole Wells via Boundary-Gated Soft-Thresholding Kalman Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.19625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Missing wireline logs hinder subsurface characterization. Deep reconstruction networks suffer from gap-boundary steps and cross-basin shifts, while interpolation and Gaussian smoothers struggle with long intervals and outliers. We propose boundary-gated soft-thresholding Kalman fusion (ST-KF), unifying multiresolution wavelet shrinkage, distance-gated residual prior learning, and closed-form robust Kalman smoothing with learning--inference decoupling. Across two public benchmarks totaling 263 wells in the Norwegian North Sea and New Zealand's Taranaki Basin, ST-KF ranks first over 0.15--100-m anchored gaps with 0.09% parameter overhead. Against the strongest of nine baselines, pooled RMSE falls by 5.0%--8.3% for bulk density and 6.4%--15.6% for compressional slowness; against the four strongest baselines, reductions are 0.7%--4.1% for neutron porosity and 1.3%--2.9% for photoelectric factor. translated_title: 基于边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合的跨点间隙与整井测井曲线稳健重构
translated_abstract: 缺失的电缆测井数据阻碍了地下表征。深度重构网络存在间隙边界台阶效应和跨盆地偏移问题，而插值方法和高斯平滑器在处理长井段和异常值时表现不佳。我们提出边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合（ST-KF），统一了多分辨率小波收缩、距离门控残差先验学习以及闭式稳健卡尔曼平滑，并实现学习与推理的解耦。在涵盖挪威北海和新西兰塔拉纳基盆地共263口井的两个公开基准数据集上，ST-KF在0.15至100米的锚定间隙上排名第一，参数开销仅为0.09%。与九个基线方法中最强者相比，体积密度的汇总RMSE下降5.0%–8.3%，纵波慢度下降6.4%–15.6%；与四个最强基线相比，中子孔隙度下降0.7%–4.1%，光电因子下降1.3%–2.9%。消融实验和敏感性分析证实了……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合方法ST-KF，以仅0.09%的参数开销统一小波收缩、残差先验学习与稳健卡尔曼平滑，在两个公开基准上实现跨间隙与整井的稳健测井曲线重构，全面超越九个基线方法。
en_tdlr: ST-KF, a boundary-gated soft-thresholding Kalman fusion framework unifying wavelet shrinkage, distance-gated residual prior learning, and closed-form robust Kalman smoothing, achieves state-of-the-art well-log reconstruction across point gaps and whole wells with only 0.09% parameter overhead on two public benchmarks.
